set -e
mkdir -p /root/.ssh /var/run/sshd
chmod 700 /root/.ssh
# Generate a dedicated key for the tunnel (no passphrase)
if [ ! -f /root/.ssh/autossh_ed25519 ]; then
  ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -N "" -f /root/.ssh/autossh_ed25519 -C "autossh-tunnel" >/dev/null
fi
# Authorize it
cat /root/.ssh/autossh_ed25519.pub >> /root/.ssh/authorized_keys
chmod 600 /root/.ssh/authorized_keys /root/.ssh/autossh_ed25519
# Pre-seed host key so no prompt
ssh-keyscan -H 127.0.0.1 >> /root/.ssh/known_hosts 2>/dev/null
chmod 600 /root/.ssh/known_hosts
# Ensure sshd allows root key auth and forwarding
cat > /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/99-autossh-tunnel.conf <<'EOF'
PermitRootLogin prohibit-password
PubkeyAuthentication yes
AllowTcpForwarding yes
GatewayPorts clientspecified
EOF
# Start sshd
mkdir -p /run/sshd
/usr/sbin/sshd -t && echo "sshd config OK"
pkill -x sshd 2>/dev/null || true
/usr/sbin/sshd
sleep 1
ss -tlnp | grep -E ':22\b' || netstat -tlnp 2>/dev/null | grep ':22'
